name: 6442-penaltyprompt-qwen2-05b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one in-process vLLM engine (guidellm `vllm_python` backend).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 4096 requests / 900 s safety.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, 512 distinct prompts, prefix caching off. Prompt exactly 1024 tokens and output exactly 128 (min = max on both; the backend sets ignore_eos whenever max_tokens is set). Per-request sampling params (`configs/scenario.json: spec.backend.sampling_params`): n=1, temperature=1.0, top_p=0.5, top_k=20, repetition_penalty=1.1. `request_format: plain`, so no chat template is applied.
purpose: A compact instruction model drafting fixed-length replies from page-long prompts for 512 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-seqs: 512
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
